full_text: Reduce all damage taken by you and your pets by {damage_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 10. | To be one with the jungle is to take what you need and endure what you must.

When an enemy dies within {radius_yards} yards, there is a {proc_chance_pct} chance that a Zombie Dog will automatically emerge. | The range of this effect is increased by your gold pickup radius. | Unlocked at level 10. | "The heads hanging in the village had their eyes sewn shut with thick thread. Whatever wicked magic held the frightful hound-beasts together was considerably stronger." —Abner Lockridge

Maximum Mana is increased by {max_pool_pct}. Regenerate {regen_pool_share_pct} of your maximum Mana per second. | Mana fuels your offensive and defensive skills. | Unlocked at level 13. | "The pool is deep and still, cool and silent. Now a fountain, now a whirlpool. Drink and be renewed." —Runic carvings on the Shallow Stone

When you are healed by a health globe, gain {gain_pct} of your maximum Mana and {primary_stat_pct} Intelligence for {duration_seconds} seconds. The Intelligence bonus stacks up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Unlocked at level 16. | "We are all connected in life and in death. Partake of the spirits of the dead and flourish like the jungle that grows wild after the fire." —Shadewalker Zunimassa

{resource_cost_share_pct} of Mana costs are paid with Life. In addition, you regenerate {life_regen_pct} of your maximum Life per second. | Unlocked at level 20. | "To give of one's self... Is there any greater gift?" —Final words spoken at the Ritual of Blood

When you deal Poison damage to an enemy, its damage is reduced by {enemy_damage_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 20. | "Their mastery of paralytic agents is astounding. The jungle, they say, provides ample demonstration of its wonders." —Abner Lockridge

Your Life, and that of your Zombie Dogs and Gargantuan are increased by {pet_life_pct}. | Additionally, you may have {pet_count} additional Zombie Dog summoned at one time. | Unlocked at level 24. | The dead are willing minions. Death to them is not unknown, therefore need not be feared.

All of your damage is increased by {damage_bonus_pct}, but your Mana costs are increased by {cost_increase_pct}. | Unlocked at level 27. | "The spirits take their toll. Best to be ready to pay." —Shadewalker Zunimassa

When you receive fatal damage, you automatically enter the spirit realm for {duration_seconds} seconds and heal to {heal_pct} of your maximum Life. | This effect may occur once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 30. | Everyone dies. Sometimes we must return to finish what we started.

When you hit enemies with your spells, you have up to a {proc_chance_pct} chance to summon a dagger-wielding Fetish to fight by your side for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 30. | The denizens of the Unformed Land are mischievous and drawn to power, always seeking to intrude upon our world, but too fickle to stay for long.

Spirit spells return {gain_resource} Mana over {duration_seconds} seconds. | Spirit spells are: | Haunt | Horrify | Mass Confusion | Soul Harvest | Spirit Barrage | Spirit Walk | Unlocked at level 36. | All spirits must move onward if they wish to return to their origins. There is no going back.

When you deal damage with Corpse Spiders, Firebomb, Plague of Toads, or Poison Dart, your Mana regeneration is increased by {regen_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 40. | "You sense but do not see. Walk beside yourself in the Unformed Land. Walk until you find yourself again, or wander lost forever." —Chant of Ordeal

While you have a Gargantuan, Zombie Dog, or Fetish summoned, your movement speed is increased by {movement_speed_pct:base}. | This bonus is increased to {movement_speed_pct:out_of_combat} while a Gargantuan, Zombie Dog, or Fetish is not in combat. | Additionally, you may have {pet_count} additional Zombie Dog summoned at one time. | Unlocked at level 45. | Establish dominance. They will obey.

Gain {heal_pct} of your maximum Life and Mana and reduce the cooldown of all of your skills by {cooldown_reduction_seconds} second when an enemy dies within {radius_yards} yards. | The range is extended by items that increase your gold pickup radius. | Unlocked at level 50. | Only a fool tries to cheat death. The wise offer a fair trade.

Reduce the cooldowns of the following skills by {cooldown_reduction_pct}: | Hex | Gargantuan | Fetish Army | Summon Zombie Dogs | Big Bad Voodoo | Mass Confusion | Unlocked at level 55. | "Befriend those who come from the Unformed Land, and they will befriend you." —Zuwadza of the Tribe of the Five Hills

Your Haunt, Locust Swarm and the damage amplification from Piranhas last almost forever. | Unlocked at level 64. | There are some terrors that cannot be outrun. Bit by bit, second by second, they consume you.

You and your pets gain {resistance_points} Physical, Poison, Fire, and Cold Resistance for every enemy within {radius_yards} yards. | The range of this effect is increased by your gold pickup radius. | Unlocked at level 66. | Know your enemies. Know their strength. Make it your own.

The damage of your Zombie Dogs and Gargantuan is increased by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Additionally, you may have {pet_count} additional Zombie Dog summoned at one time. | Unlocked at level 68. | In the deepest hour of night, they emerge for the hunt.

You deal {damage_bonus_pct} additional damage to enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 60. | Take your enemies into your confidence. Bring them close, so that they may share the fruits of your efforts.
